profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Vantor
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with over 20 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable 
software systems. Proven technical leader with a strong background in full-stack development, cloud-native 
architectures, agile methodologies, and mentoring engineering teams.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed flight software for the Legion satellite constellation
• Built GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and integration, reducing manual overhead and improving code quality
• Led a re-architecture of command and telemetry database tools, improving system performance and developer workflow
• Prototyped on-orbit ML model execution as part of an R&D effort
• Conducted performance benchmarking of ML models on multiple GPU and NPU architectures to inform hardware and deployment decisions

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior member of an agile scrum team working in a Scaled Agile Framework organization collaborating with product managers, data scientists, and infrastructure teams on a micro-service architecture, much of which was cloud-based (AWS). This involved distributing software and systems at scale via Auto Scaling Groups, Kubernetes (EKS), and Lambda. My role involved designing, developing, and deploying functional capabilities of the Ground System including core image processing systems, interfaces with business systems, and web services initiatives.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a new service oriented architecture for the Remote Ground Terminal Program - a transportable ground receiving and processing tool built to collect remote sensing data from commercial satellites that send and receive optical and synthetic aperture radar signals. In addition, I provided support and maintenance of the MDA image processing sub-system for DigitalGlobe.

The majority of this work involved the Agile development of RESTful services in Java using Camel, BPMS, and Spring frameworks. Unit testing done via JUnit and Mockito. Functional testing written in Java and driven by Cucumber from Gherkin feature files.

positions.title: Founder/Head Brewer
positions.description: Founded Zephyr Brewing Company in the heart of Denver's River North (RiNo) district.  Ran the brewhouse, where we manufactured a variety of styles, the trademarks of which were the Blood Orange Pale Ale, Belgian Wit, and the Belgian Quadrupel.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical Lead for new development cycle on the SBIRS program
• Led efforts in designing an entirely new ground software system
• Trained and mentored new employees
• Developed proxy agents/device drivers for satellite ground station front end hardware

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed expert systems in C/C++ and CLIPS (the beginnings of AI)
• Developed jBPM/XML workflows to configure ground stations for automatic satellite signal acquisition
• Implemented design enhancements / integrated COTS resulting in savings of $500K
• Received corporate level Celebration of Excellence Award presented in Washington DC

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed user interfaces allowing satellite ground station operators to configure hardware, transmit and receive satellite data
• Performed trade studies for a COTS Messaging Middleware/IPC solution and a COTS Network Management solution
positions.insights: User Interface Design, IPC and +1 skill

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
• Managed the University of Colorado’s memory quota system
• Designed and implemented Perl and shell scripts on a daily basis
• Setup and maintained Unix servers/workstations running Solaris
